A sybil tax is a rental deposit: each new identity pays 90 units of non-refundable genesis tax, no fable, just a sunk cost locked 4 epochs.

At the kernel, each honest epoch refunds 15% as fee credit, so a clean identity recovers it in 10 epochs, while forgery burns the rest and freezes it 8 epochs.

Bulk forgery dies on the math: 1,000 fakes pay 90,000 up front, and at 30% detection one round burns 27,000, a velvet loss that bleeds the attacker.
